title: JobBackfillService
responsibility: Import elapsed historical job durations once per result source and report duplicate, missing and invalid timing.

inputs.name: JobBackfillService.constructor.history
inputs.description: Open JobHistoryRepository used for the action. The caller owns its lifetime unless withJobHistory opened it.

inputs.name: JobBackfillService.import.root
inputs.description: Historical results root; only results-* collection directories are traversed to a bounded depth. Filesystem errors at the collection boundary propagate.

outputs.name: JobBackfillService.import
outputs.description: Counts imported, duplicate and skipped records, plus per-file parse, validation or database errors. An unreadable result does not stop other imports.
